description:
As a loan officer
  I want a dashboard that summarises the loan portfolio
  So that I can see total exposure and monthly inflow at a glance

elements.name: Dashboard loads with all summary tiles

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
the "Portfolio Dashboard" page should be displayed
the "Dashboard" navigation link should be active
the dashboard should show the following summary tiles:

elements.name: Dashboard figures match an independent calculation of the portfolio data

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
the dashboard summary should match my own calculation from the loan data

elements.name: Principal-by-type bar chart is visible and renders valid non-zero data

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
the principal by loan type chart should be visible
every loan type bar should have a value greater than zero
the bar values should add up to the "Total principal" tile

name: Portfolio dashboard

description:
As a borrower
  I want to enter my loan details
  So that I can see my monthly EMI and how the total payment is split

elements.name: Calculated EMI matches an independently computed value – Home loan A

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "25L", an interest rate of 10% and a tenure of 10 years
I calculate the EMI
the monthly EMI shown should match my own calculation
the total interest and total payment shown should match my own calculation

elements.name: Calculated EMI matches an independently computed value – Home loan B

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "50L", an interest rate of 7.5% and a tenure of 15 years
I calculate the EMI
the monthly EMI shown should match my own calculation
the total interest and total payment shown should match my own calculation

elements.name: Calculated EMI matches an independently computed value – Personal loan

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "10L", an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
I calculate the EMI
the monthly EMI shown should match my own calculation
the total interest and total payment shown should match my own calculation

elements.name: Calculated EMI matches an independently computed value – Small, short loan

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "50000", an interest rate of 18% and a tenure of 1 years
I calculate the EMI
the monthly EMI shown should match my own calculation
the total interest and total payment shown should match my own calculation

elements.name: Pie chart is visible and both sections contain values greater than zero

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "25L", an interest rate of 10% and a tenure of 10 years
I calculate the EMI
the EMI breakdown pie chart should be visible
the pie chart should have 2 sections with values greater than zero
the pie chart sections should equal the principal and total interest

elements.name: Values can be set with the sliders

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I set the sliders to a loan amount of "10L", an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
I calculate the EMI
the monthly EMI shown should match my own calculation

elements.name: Yearly bar chart shows one bar per year and its tooltip matches the schedule

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "10L", an interest rate of 12% and a tenure of 5 years
I calculate the EMI
the yearly repayment bar chart should be visible
the bar chart should contain 5 bars
I hover over the bar for year 3
the tooltip should show the principal and interest for year 3 from my own schedule

elements.name: Invalid input is rejected with a helpful message – zero amount

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "0", an interest rate of 10% and a tenure of 10 years
I calculate the EMI
I should see the validation message "Loan amount must be between"
no EMI result should be displayed

elements.name: Invalid input is rejected with a helpful message – rate too high

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "25L", an interest rate of 45% and a tenure of 10 years
I calculate the EMI
I should see the validation message "Interest rate must be between 0.1% and 30%"
no EMI result should be displayed

elements.name: Invalid input is rejected with a helpful message – fractional years

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "EMI Calculator" page
I enter a loan amount of "25L", an interest rate of 10% and a tenure of 2.5 years
I calculate the EMI
I should see the validation message "Tenure must be a whole number of years"
no EMI result should be displayed

name: EMI calculator

description:
As a loan officer
  I want to filter the loan book
  So that I can review a subset of loans and their totals

elements.name: Filtering by All / All shows only matching loans with correct totals

steps.name: I open the LoanLens application
I navigate to the "Reports" page
I filter the report by loan type "All" and status "All"
every row in the report should have type "All" and status "All"
the report should contain the same loans as the data source for that filter
the report totals should match my own calculation
